report.title: Markdown List Auto-Completion Adds Symbol to Current Line Instead of New Line
report.body: ### Describe the bug When using the Markdown editor in the content management system, the auto-completion feature for unordered lists is behaving incorrectly. When entering `- 123` or `* 123` and pressing Enter, the system appends an extra `-` or `*` to the end of the current line instead of inserting it on a new line. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open the Markdown editor in the content publishing interface. 2. Type `- 123` (or `* 123`) in the editor. 3. Press the Enter key to create a new line. ## Expected Behavior - The current line should remain as `- 123` (or `* 123`). - A new line should be automatically prepended with `-` (or `*`) to continue the unordered list. ## Actual Behavior - The current line becomes `- 123-` (or `* 123*`) after pressing Enter. - The line break is not properly applied, and the list symbol is incorrectly appended to the existing line. ### The version of Memos you're using 0.25.2 ### Screenshots or additional context

preconditions: the user is signed in and the memo editor is visible on the home page
steps: Click on the memo editor text area
plan.expected: The first line of the editor still reads "- 123" with nothing appended, and a new second line begins with "- " to continue the list.
plan.reported_actual: After pressing Enter, the current line becomes "- 123-" (or "* 123*") and the list symbol is appended to the existing line instead of a new line.
missing: assumed: the 'Markdown editor in the content publishing interface' is the memo editor on the home page
Which browser and OS were used?
Does the issue also occur when typing the '* 123' variant (the steps use the '-' variant only)?
plan.summary: Pressing Enter after '- 123' in the memo editor appends '-' to the current line instead of a new line
